name: questail
description: Personal game archive — import, analyze, and own your game history

scripts.eval:baseline: pnpm --silent eval > /tmp/questail-eval.log 2>&1; code=$?; cat /tmp/questail-eval.log; grep -qF "[dryrun] 총점 26/27 (tool)" /tmp/questail-eval.log && grep -qF -- "- C2-05 " /tmp/questail-eval.log && test "$code" -eq 1 && echo "[release] eval baseline OK: 26/27, C2-05 only, exit 1"
scripts.release:check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @questail/core --filter @questail/collie --filter @questail/cli pack --dry-run && pnpm eval:baseline
